limitations: Three formal samples per cohort do not characterize p95 or sustained real-time reliability.
Reverse chronological execution may contain time/temperature drift; the final configuration is repeated at the end.
PDD, VSA checkpoint/runtime, QAD precision, and NVFP4 VAE are not all lossless changes.
Exact engineering means byte equality on this retained request, not a universal perceptual-quality guarantee.
This standalone case does not measure ASR, LLM, queueing, browser playback, or rolling history.
Historical measurements are separate from the fresh reverse run; pending cells are never filled with old data.
